info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Certificates API provides users with the ability to retrieve a list of certificates associated with educational enrollments. This endpoint allows stakeholders, such as educational institutions and administrators, to efficiently access and manage enrollment records and their corresponding certificates. It supports typical use cases involving reporting, compliance, and data analysis. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate enrollment certificate data into their applications and facilitate streamlined access for various educational workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about enrollment certificates, including their status and associated data. Use this API to view certificates for specific enrollments based on parameters you provide.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve certificate information related to enrollments. Ensure that you provide the necessary data structured according to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the enrollment certificate data.
